title: German-Style Grilled Duck Skewers
description: A twist on traditional German cuisine, these grilled duck skewers are marinated in a mixture of Asian-inspired flavors and grilled to perfection.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic, ginger, salt, and black pepper. Blend until smooth.
Add the chopped onion to the blender and blend until well combined.
Add the olive oil and blend until emulsified.
Place the duck legs in a large bowl and pour the marinade over them.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Thread the duck legs onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 5-7 minutes per side, or until the duck is cooked through.
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
